highlights.text: Engaged in a heated physical and verbal clash with Qazi Touqeer during the captaincy task.
Received aggressive threats from Qazi Touqeer telling him to stay within limits.
Almost got into a physical fight and pushed Qazi Touqeer during an explosive captaincy task
Fought alongside Kushal Tanwar and Yung DSA to become the first captain of the house
Broke down emotionally while recalling his grandfather's unfulfilled dream.
Competed in a fierce first captaincy race alongside Gullu and Yung DSA.
Spoke fondly about his mother and wife, sharing his love for them.
An old interview resurfaced where he previously claimed he would never join Bigg Boss.
Entered the show as Panchayat's 'Damaad Ji'.
